headline: Man United fan group call for unified pre-derby protest amid season ticket 'fiasco'
description: A Manchester United fan group has called for a unified protest against the "season ticket ban fiasco" ahead of Sunday's derby against Manchester City.

headline: Liverpool announce Turkish Airlines as main shirt sponsor from 2027
description:

headline: Dominik Szoboszlai: Liverpool will be unstoppable if intensity is rediscovered
description: Liverpool midfielder Dominik Szoboszlai has said "no one can stop us" should his side rediscover their intensity of old.

headline: Premier League 2026-27 kits: Ranking every jersey released
description: The 2026-27 Premier League season is finally here, and that means new home and away jerseys for all 20 clubs. Here they all are -- ranked!

headline: Premier League clubs are overspending on wingers who can't score goals
description: After Messi and Ronaldo proved wingers can do more than cross the ball, why are Premier League clubs paying so much for so little production?

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal set for Rice talks to ward off Real Madrid interest
description: Real Madrid are eyeing up Declan Rice, but Arsenal are making moves to keep him. Transfer Talk has the latest.
